title: More visibility and control around API usage
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: clearer usage tracking, better model controls, repaired app deployments, and fresh community signage.

A new /api/usage endpoint and model-level usage signals give builders clearer ways to track consumption, while pending-spend tracking and data-access repairs make those numbers behave more reliably. The pricing UI also got a clarity pass, because billing information should not require archaeology.

Seedance-Pro now accepts an aspect-ratio parameter for more intentional video framing. API keys can also be scoped by model permissions, giving apps a cleaner way to expose exactly the models they intend to use.

The app collection was cleaned up and its Hacktoberfest-era structure renamed to simply apps. Model Monitor deployment paths, production-branch publishing, and SPA redirects were fixed, while the changelog generator joined the app registry. Less mystery-meat routing, more working tools.
